description: This file defines a React functional component for a Watchlist page that manages a list of stock symbols and associated notes. It implements client-side CRUD operations with local state management, including adding, editing, deleting, and sorting watchlist items, along with accessibility features.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a re-render by updating the version state.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new symbol to the watchlist after validation.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for a specific symbol.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves changes made during editing to the symbol and note.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and performs the deletion of a symbol after user confirmation.
